about:
tests/fixtures/steady/places_tree_2026.json: her places as perception placed them on Tree Dungeon, for the
steady walks' estimator (gamelab.motion.steady, analysis.walkfit's) to be checked on: R1's grind whole, the hour's and the thief's
stretches (each with its neighbours), columnar, each column's first value then the differences to it, place by place:
t (ms), x and y (tenths of a unit); and run by run ([value, how many places], ...): platform (-1 none), mode (0
ground, 1 air, 2 rope), how (0 tag, 1 camera, 2 dot, 3 other).

r1.what: R1, RiceBaby's grind of 2026-11-02 00:09:36-00:14:57, every place the perception service's scene records had (20261102-000738-perceive.jsonl)

hour.what: her hour of 2026-11-02 00:17:48-00:53:06 (R2-R3's file): each stretch the estimator found, 3 places either side

thief.what: BugBaby on Tree Dungeon: the bot's hunt of 10-26 22:54 to 10-27 02:36 (20261026-225441-perceive-part2.jsonl) and the user's play of 10-30 08:26-08:31 (golden clip): each stretch, 3 places either side
